renderer_config.name: sync_mode
renderer_config.description: Enables synchronous rendering mode for debugging purposes.

renderer_config.name: log_file_path
renderer_config.description: Set the path to the log file for logging output.

renderer_config.name: log_level
renderer_config.description: Set the log level for logging output (e.g. "verbose", "info", "warn", "error").

renderer_config.name: enable_profiling
renderer_config.description: Enable internal profiling. Adds overhead when enabled.

renderer_config.name: read_gpu_transforms
renderer_config.description: Use GPU world transform propagation during rendering.

renderer_config.name: keep_system_alive
renderer_config.description:
Keep the renderer system alive after all instances are destroyed so the next create reuses it.

    When omitted (``None``), the native layer defaults to enabled.

renderer_config.name: active_cuda_gpus
renderer_config.description: Comma-separated CUDA device indices to use for rendering (e.g., "0,1,2").

renderer_config.name: datastore_cache
renderer_config.description:
Protocol-prefixed datastore cache configuration used by UJITSO. Supported values include
    ``grpcdns://host:port``, ``grpcdns_notls://host:port``, and ``local://path``. When omitted,
    existing defaults and environment-variable behavior are preserved.

renderer_config.name: selection_outline_enabled
renderer_config.description:
Enable the selection-outline post-process pass. Defaults to ``True`` when unset.
    Init-time only; toggling requires recreating the renderer.

renderer_config.name: selection_outline_width
renderer_config.description:
Selection outline width in pixels. Valid range is ``0..15`` (the underlying RTX
    outline pipeline cap); out-of-range values are clamped by the renderer.
    Init-time only; changing requires recreating the renderer. Default: 2.

renderer_config.name: selection_fill_mode
renderer_config.description:
Selection-outline fill (interior) mode. Accepts a :class:`SelectionFillMode`
    member or the equivalent ``int`` value (``0..3``). Out-of-range values raise
    :class:`ValueError`.

    Init-time only; changing requires recreating the renderer.
    Default: :attr:`SelectionFillMode.GLOBAL`.

renderer_config.name: enable_geometry_streaming
renderer_config.description: Enable geometry streaming. Disabled by default when ``None``.

renderer_config.name: enable_geometry_streaming_lod
renderer_config.description: Geometry streaming LOD opt-in config entry.

renderer_config.name: enable_spg
renderer_config.description:
Set to False to disable Sensor Processing Graphs (SPG), enabled by default.
       This is a global setting, applying to all active renderer instances.

renderer_config.name: suppress_deprecation_warnings
renderer_config.description:
Suppress Python and native runtime warnings emitted by deprecated OVRTX APIs.

    Compile-time deprecation diagnostics for C and C++ consumers are unaffected. When ``None`` or
    ``False``, runtime deprecation warnings remain enabled.

renderer_config.name: motion_bvh
renderer_config.description:
Motion BVH mode for sensor pipelines (lidar, radar, acoustic).

    Accepts a :class:`MotionBvh` member, the equivalent ``int`` value (``0..2``),
    or the strings ``"disable"``, ``"enable"``, or ``"auto"``.

    When ``None`` (default), motion BVH is disabled and no config entry is sent.
    Sensor workflows should pass :attr:`MotionBvh.AUTO` or :attr:`MotionBvh.ENABLE`.
    Init-time only; changing requires recreating the renderer.

renderer_config.name: sensors_allowed_deprecation_base
renderer_config.description:
Allow all soft-deprecated sensor versions while pinned to a specific release:
    ``"<major>.<minor>.<patch>"`` (e.g. ``"0.4.0"``). Soft-deprecated versions are rejected by
    default; deprecation is allowed only when this matches the current framework version,
    so it must be revisited on every framework upgrade.

renderer_config.name: aftermath_mode
renderer_config.description:
NVIDIA Nsight Aftermath diagnostics mode.

    Accepts an :class:`AftermathMode` member, the equivalent ``int`` value (``0..2``), or
    ``"disable"``, ``"enable"``, or ``"auto"``. Disable skips Aftermath initialization, enable
    selects explicit diagnostics initialization, and ``None`` or auto selects the initialization
    mode automatically. This setting is process-global and must match the first renderer while the
    renderer system is alive.

renderer_config.name: texture_streaming_mode
renderer_config.description:
Texture streaming mode.

    Accepts a :class:`TextureStreamingMode` member, the equivalent ``int`` value
    (``0..2``), or the strings ``"disable"``, ``"synchronous"``, or
    ``"asynchronous"``. When ``None``, asynchronous mode is used.

    Synchronous mode controls texture-feedback processing; it does not make all
    texture loading operations synchronous. This setting is process-global and
    applies to all active renderer instances.

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:multigpu:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enable the use of multiple GPUs for rendering when present.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/realtime/mgpu/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:multigpu:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enable the use of multiple GPUs for rendering when present.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/mgpu/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:scenePartitioning:showAllPartitionsByDefault
rtx_schema.description:
Allow cameras without a scene partition to trace all foreground partitions.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/scenePartitioning/showAllPartitionsByDefault')

rtx_schema.name: renderingColorSpace
rtx_schema.description:
Describes a renderer's working (linear) color space where all the renderer/shader math is expected to happen. When no renderingColorSpace is provided, the renderer uses its own default.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/renderingColorSpace')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:reflectionVisibleRoughnessThreshold
rtx_schema.description:
When a light is invisible to camera rays, it will also be invisible in rough reflections where the roughness is higher than this value.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/invisLightReflectionsGhostFactor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:refractionVisibleRoughnessThreshold
rtx_schema.description:
When a light is invisible to camera rays, it will also be invisible in rough refractions where the roughness is less than this value.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/invisLightRefractionsGhostFactor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:visibilityOverride
rtx_schema.description:
Decide whether lights are visible or invisible to the camera.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/showLights')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:materials:time:useWallClock
rtx_schema.description:
Use actual elapsed time for animation instead of simulated time. Useful for interactive applications where the timeline is not playing.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/animationTimeUseWallclock')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:background:source:texture:path
rtx_schema.description:
Background Texture Path
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/background/source/texture/path')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:background:source:texture:colorSpace
rtx_schema.description:
Set the color space of the backplate texture
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/background/source/texture/colorSpace')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:background:source:texture:luminanceScale
rtx_schema.description:
Scales the brightness of the backplate texture
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/background/source/texture/luminanceScale')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:background:source:texture:textureMode
rtx_schema.description:
Background Texture Sample Mode
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/background/source/texture/textureMode')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:background:source:color
rtx_schema.description:
A constant color for background
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/background/source/color')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:geometry:rayOffset
rtx_schema.description:
Offset used to avoid ray-triangle intersections. The default of 0 causes RTX to calculate the appropriate offset automatically.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/rayOffset')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:dome:baking:denoising:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Denoise the Dome Light texture with the OptiX denoiser after it has been baked from an MDL material.
        Lets a low baking sample count produce a clean texture, at the cost of extra GPU memory during the bake.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/domeLight/baking/denoising/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:dome:baking:resolution
rtx_schema.description:
The baking resolution of the Dome Light texture when an MDL material is used as its image source.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/domeLight/baking/resolution')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:dome:samplingStrategy
rtx_schema.description:
- imageBasedLighting: Most accurate even for high-frequency Dome Light textures. Can introduce sampling artifacts in real-time mode.
                 - approximatedImageBasedLighting: Fast and artifacts-free sampling in real-time mode but only works well with a low-frequency texture,
                     for example a sky with no sun disc where the sun is instead a separate Distant Light.
                 - environmentMappedImageBasedLighting: Only sampled for reflection and refraction. Fastest, but least accurate. Good for cases where the Dome Light
                     contributes less than other light sources.
                     (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/domeLight/upperLowerStrategy')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:lights:shadowRayOffset
rtx_schema.description:
Offset applied to the shadow ray origin along the surface normal to reduce self-shadowing artifacts.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/shadowBias')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:materials:refractionAsOpacity
rtx_schema.description:
Force all refractive paths to opacity instead, accumulating opacity as alpha. Allows compositing refractive objects over a background.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/material/translucencyAsOpacity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:materials:time:override
rtx_schema.description:
Overrides the time value provided to MDL materials.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/animationTime')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:wireframe:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enable wireframe mode
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/wireframe/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:wireframe:perPrimThicknessWorldSpace
rtx_schema.description:
Interprets the per-primitive wireframe thickness value in world space instead of screen space.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/wireframe/wireframeThicknessWorldSpace')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:wireframe:thickness
rtx_schema.description:
Thickness of the lines in wireframe mode.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/wireframe/wireframeThickness')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:wireframePrimThicknessWorldSpace
rtx_schema.description:
Interprets the global wireframe thickness value in world space instead of screen space.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/wireframe/globalWireframeThicknessWorldSpace')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:raytracing:picking:occluded:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Whether picking goes through objects to include those that maybe occluded byt others.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/picking/occluded/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:syntheticdata:sensors:returnAllBBoxesOutsideFrustum
rtx_schema.display_name: Include 3D Bounding Boxes outside the sensor frustum
rtx_schema.description:
Include 3D Bounding Boxes outside the sensor frustum when outputting the SDG ground truth AOVs.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/syntheticdata/sensors/returnAllBBoxesOutsideFrustum')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:minimal:mode
rtx_schema.description:
Shading mode: 0 = No Rendering, 1 = Constant Diffuse, 2 = Texture Diffuse, 3 = Diffuse/Glossy/Emission.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/minimal/mode')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:minimal:constantColor

Color used in Constant Diffuse minimal shading mode.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/minimal/constantColor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:minimal:castShadows
rtx_schema.description:
Global toggle to cast shadows in RTX minimal render mode.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/minimal/castShadows')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:minimal:useMinimalPipeline
rtx_schema.description:
When true and shading mode is Diffuse/Glossy/Emission, use the lightweight minimal ray-tracing pipeline with reduced payload sizes.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/minimal/useMinimalPipeline')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:minimal:dlss:execMode
rtx_schema.description:
Auto: Selects the best DLSS Mode for the current output resolution.
                 Performance: Higher performance than balanced mode.
                 Balanced: Balanced for optimized performance and image quality.
                 Quality: Higher image quality than balanced mode.
            (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/minimal/dlss/execMode')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:sceneDb:ambientLightColor
rtx_schema.description:
Global ambient environment light color.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/sceneDb/ambientLightColor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:sceneDb:ambientLightIntensity
rtx_schema.description:
Global ambient environment brightness (0-10). A value of 0 disables ambient lighting.

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:dlss:frameGeneration

Enables DLSS Frame Generation on Ada and later GPUs. Frame Generation boosts performance by using AI to generate additional, high-quality frames.

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:dlss:frameGenerationInterpolatedFrameCount

Number of interpolated frames to insert between each real frame.

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:post:dlss:execMode
rtx_schema.description:
Auto: Selects the best DLSS Mode for the current output resolution.
Performance: Higher performance than balanced mode.
Balanced: Balanced for optimized performance and image quality.
Quality: Higher image quality than balanced mode.
            (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/post/dlss/execMode')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:ambientLight:color
rtx_schema.description:
Color of a constant ambient lighting term. Sometimes useful in situations where dome lights are too expensive or completely shadowed.

        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/sceneDb/ambientLightColor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:ambientLight:intensity
rtx_schema.description:
Intensity of a constant ambient lighting term. Sometimes useful in situations where dome lights are too expensive or completely shadowed.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/sceneDb/ambientLightIntensity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:ambientocclusion:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Global toggle for the ambient occlusion pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/ambientOcclusion/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:ambientocclusion:rayLength
rtx_schema.description:
Radius around the shading point to search for occlusions. Measured in cm. Higher numbers give a smoother effect, lower numbers give a tighter effect and can be used to avoid unwanted self-shadows such as from the ceiling of a room.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/ambientOcclusion/rayLength')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:directLighting:samples
rtx_schema.description:
Higher values increase the direct lighting quality at the cost of performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/directLighting/sampledLighting/samplesPerPixel')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:ecoMode:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enables eco mode, which stops rendering after a certain number of idle frames to reduce power consumption.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/ecoMode/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:ecoMode:maxFramesWithoutChange
rtx_schema.description:
When eco mode is enabled, stop rendering after this many idle frames in order to reduce power consumption.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/ecoMode/maxFramesWithoutChange')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:fractionalOpacity
rtx_schema.description:
When disabled, materials will interpret an opacity map as having a binary on/off value instead of smooth variation. Enabling this comes at the cost of performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/fractionalCutoutOpacity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:indirectdiffuse:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Global toggle for the indirect diffuse pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/indirectDiffuse/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:indirectdiffuse:intensity
rtx_schema.description:
Scales the contribution of the indirect diffuse pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/indirectDiffuse/scalingFactor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:indirectdiffuse:maxBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Number of bounces for refraction rays.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/indirectDiffuse/maxBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:indirectdiffuse:maxRayUnexposedIntensity
rtx_schema.description:
Clamp the indirect diffuse ray intensities to avoid fireflies at the cost of energy loss. This value is automatically scaled with the exposure.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/indirectDiffuse/maxRayUnexposedIntensity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:indirectdiffuse:samples
rtx_schema.description:
Number of samples for indirect diffuse. Higher values improve image quality at the cost of performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/indirectDiffuse/fetchSampleCount')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:reflections:maxBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Number of bounces for glossy reflection rays.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/reflections/maxReflectionBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:reflections:roughnessCacheThreshold
rtx_schema.description:
Materials with glossy reflections rougher than this value will use cached values rather than recalculating the reflected color directly. Higher values increase quality at the cost of performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/reflections/maxRoughness')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:reflections:samples
rtx_schema.description:
Higher values increase the reflections quality at the cost of performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/reflections/sampledLighting/samplesPerPixel')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:maxBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Number of bounces for refraction rays.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/maxRefractionBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:sss:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Global toggle for the subsurface scattering pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/subsurface/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:sss:samples
rtx_schema.description:
Number of samples for subsurface scattering. Higher values improve image quality at the cost of performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/subsurface/maxSamplePerFrame')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:caustics:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enables the caustics photon tracing pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/caustics/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:caustics:filterIterations
rtx_schema.description:
Number of iterations for the denoiser applied to the results of the caustics tracing pass.
       (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/caustics/eawFilteringSteps')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:caustics:photonCount
rtx_schema.description:
Number of photons (thousands) to shoot from each light.
       (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/caustics/photonCountMultiplier')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:caustics:photonMaxBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Maximum number of bounces to compute for each photon path.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/caustics/photonMaxBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:directLighting:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Use sampled direct lighting for area lights instead of the LTC approximation.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/directLighting/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:directLighting:maxRayUnexposedIntensity
rtx_schema.description:
Clamps the brightness of each ray when sampling direct lighting. Lower values reduce noise but increase bias. This value is automatically scaled with the exposure.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/directLighting/sampledLighting/maxRayUnexposedIntensity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:directLighting:ris:meshLights
rtx_schema.description:
Enables direct illumination sampling of geometry with emissive materials.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/directLighting/sampledLighting/ris/meshLights')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:reflections:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enables the glossy reflections pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/reflections/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:reflections:maxRayUnexposedIntensity
rtx_schema.description:
Clamps the brightness of each ray when sampling reflections. Lower values reduce noise but increase bias. This value is automatically scaled with the exposure.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/reflections/sampledLighting/maxRayUnexposedIntensity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:depthCorrection
rtx_schema.description:
Improves DoF for translucent (refractive) objects, but can result in worse performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/virtualDepth')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enables the refraction (transmission) pass.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:maxRayUnexposedIntensity
rtx_schema.description:
Clamps the brightness of each ray when sampling refractions. Lower values reduce noise but increase bias. This value is automatically scaled with the exposure.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/maxRayUnexposedIntensity')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:motionCorrection
rtx_schema.description:
Enables motion vectors for translucent (refractive) objects, which can improve temporal rendering such as denoising, but can result in worse performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/virtualMotion')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:reflectionInRefraction
rtx_schema.description:
Enables the calculation of reflections when seen through a refractive object. Enabling this is more correct but leads to worse performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/reflectAtAllBounce')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:refractions:roughnessSampling
rtx_schema.description:
Enables the calculation of glossy (rough) refractions.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/translucency/sampleRoughness')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:sss:transmission:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Enables sampling of transmissive subsurface scattering (i.e. light scattering through an object from behind). More accurate, but increases noise and render time.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/subsurface/transmission/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:sss:transmission:samples
rtx_schema.description:
Number of samples to trace when evaluating transmissive subsurface scattering. Higher numbers improve image quality at the cost of render time.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/subsurface/transmission/bsdfSampleCount')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rt:sss:transmission:scatteringSamples
rtx_schema.description:
Number of connections to the surface to make to evalute in-scattered light for each transmission sample. Higher numbers improve image quality at the cost of render time.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/raytracing/subsurface/transmission/perBsdfScatteringSampleCount')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:adaptiveSampling:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
When enabled, the renderer measures the noise of each pixel and stops sampling when 'Target error' is reached.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/adaptiveSampling/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:adaptiveSampling:targetError
rtx_schema.description:
The noise value treshold after which each pixel will no longer be sampled when adaptive sampling is enabled.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/adaptiveSampling/targetError')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:denoising:blendFactor
rtx_schema.description:
Radius of the pixel filter. Larger values give a blurrier, less noisy result.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/optixDenoiser/blendFactor')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:denoising:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
Runs the selected denoiser on the image.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/optixDenoiser/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:denoising:optix:denoiseAOVs

        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/optixDenoiser/AOV')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:denoising:optix:temporal
rtx_schema.description:
Uses motion information to reduce frame-to-frame flickering artifacts in the denoiser.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/optixDenoiser/temporalMode/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:limits:maxBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Maximum number of ray bounces for any ray type. Higher values give more accurate results, but worse performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/maxBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:limits:maxFogBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Maximum number of ray bounces for fog volumes. Higher values give more accurate results, but worse performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/ptfog/maxBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:limits:extraSpecularAndTransmissiveBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Additional bounce budget available to specular reflections and any transmissive paths.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/extraSpecularAndTransmissiveBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:limits:maxVolumeBounces
rtx_schema.description:
Maximum number of ray bounces for non-uniform volumes. Higher values give more accurate results, but worse performance.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/ptvol/maxBounces')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:pixelFilter:filter
rtx_schema.description:
Sampling pattern for pixel filtering.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/aa/op')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:pixelFilter:radius
rtx_schema.description:
Radius of the pixel filter. Larger values give a blurrier, less noisy result.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/pathtracing/aa/filterRadius')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:samplesPerPixel
rtx_schema.description:
Maximum number of samples per pixel. Higher numbers improve image quality at the cose of longer render time.

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:lightCache:enabled

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:pt:samplesPerIteration

rtx_schema.name: exposure:fStop
rtx_schema.description:
f-stop of the aperture when calculating exposure. Smaller numbers
                 create a brighter image, larger numbers darker.
                 Note that the `fStop` attribute also models the diameter of the camera
                 aperture, but for specifying depth of field.  For practical
                 purposes it is useful to keep the exposure and the depth of field
                 controls separate.
                 (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/post/tonemap/fNumber')

rtx_schema.name: exposure:iso
rtx_schema.description:
The speed rating of the sensor or film when calculating exposure.
                 Higher numbers give a brighter image, lower numbers darker.
                 (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/post/tonemap/filmIso')

rtx_schema.name: exposure:responsivity
rtx_schema.description:
Scalar multiplier representing overall responsivity of the
                 sensor system to light when calculating exposure. Intended to be
                 used as a per camera/lens system measured scaling value.
                 Note: RTX needs this to be 0.8821367311933349 to match the USD
                 result.
                 (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/post/tonemap/responsivity')

rtx_schema.name: exposure:time
rtx_schema.description:
Time in seconds that the sensor is exposed to light when calculating exposure.
                 Longer exposure times create a brighter image, shorter times darker.
                 Note that shutter:open and shutter:close model essentially the
                 same property of a physical camera, but are for specifying the
                 size of the motion blur streak which is for practical purposes
                 useful to keep separate.
                 (deprecated carb default value: 0.02)
                 (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/post/tonemap/exposureTime')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rollingShutter:lineExposure
rtx_schema.description:

        A pair of (0, 1) indicates no additional line exposure beyond the global shutter interval.

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rtpt:gaussian:accumulatedAlbedo:enabled
rtx_schema.description:
When enabled, gaussian SH0 albedo is opacity-weighted across up to maxGaussiansToAccumulate hits and the result overrides the GBuffer diffuse albedo.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/rtpt/gaussian/accumulatedAlbedo/enabled')

rtx_schema.name: omni:rtx:rtpt:gaussian:maxGaussiansToAccumulate
rtx_schema.description:
Total hit budget for gaussian depth/albedo accumulation. Values up to 48 use a single pass over the closest N hits. Values above 48 enable a multi-batch traversal that continues until the budget is reached, the 95% opacity threshold is hit, or no more candidates are found. Set to -1 for unlimited accumulation (stops only on opacity threshold or BVH exhaust). Set to 0 to disable accumulation entirely (Accumulate Depth/Albedo are ignored). Higher values reduce ghosting in dense gaussian regions at proportional perf cost.
        (deprecated carb setting path: '/rtx/rtpt/gaussian/maxGaussiansToAccumulate')
